LV2_URI_MAP_TERMS.doc: The terms of the LV2 URI Map specification (uri-map.lv2, from lv2 1.18.10), each mapped under its own name with its status for us (docs/data-layout.md).

uri-map.lv2.ruling: LV2 deprecates the uri-map extension (owl:deprecated on http://lv2plug.in/ns/ext/uri-map); a consumer that reads it does so to refuse it.
